description: This line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) on the y-axis against the ratio of activated parameters on the x-axis, which is labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio(%)" and ranges from 25% to 100% in linear scale with tick marks at regular intervals. The y-axis, labeled "Eval PPL," ranges from approximately 11.5 to 14.0. The plot contains three distinct lines: a dashed red line representing "Only MoHD FFN" that remains constant at a value of approximately 11.7 across the entire x-axis range; a solid dark blue line representing "Only MoHD ATTN" that starts at approximately 11.6 at 100% activated parameters, decreases slightly to about 11.7 at 75%, then rises to approximately 12.1 at 50%, and sharply increases to about 13.9 at 25%; and a solid blue line with cross markers representing "MoHD ATTN + MLP" that begins at approximately 11.6 at 100%, rises gradually to about 12.0 at 75%, continues to increase to approximately 12.1 at 50%, and reaches approximately 13.1 at 25%.
